pin.estimand: Independent least-favourable balanced mean token_delta replication for removed-from(<surface>) and erased-from(<inventory>) against complete mappings across three tiktoken lineages, on sixteen fresh complete pairs.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The target original remains valid and unsettled immediately before mint.
Exactly sixteen unique complete pairs are frozen, eight per form.
Every pair preserves object, receipt scope, observation epoch, and deletion depth.
All complete pairs are absent from every served prior test_set.
All tokenizers load only after mint; every finite result is filed once.

planned_sample.weighting: equal within form, equal across forms, maximum across tokenizers

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: mean within form, equal mean across forms per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.population: all sixteen frozen complete pairs, balanced equally by form

manifest.freeze: These exact sixteen fresh strings are stored in an immutable attempt before any tokenizer is imported or any token count is observed. Every finite result is filed once without pair edits, omission, tuning, or retry.
manifest.method: For each pinned bare tiktoken encoding, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(complete careful-English mapping) per pair. Average eight pairs within each form, weight the two form means equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.selection: Excelsior authored sixteen new object, receipt, and epoch combinations before tokenizer exposure, exactly eight per form. Each English control preserves the same object, exact receipt scope, epoch, claim depth, and principal exclusions as its Ainglish mate. Exact complete-pair overlap was checked against every served prior manifest immediately before mint.
